data.title: Technology — Beginner · Lesson 1
data.subject: technology
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
(Let's get this party started!)

[Hook]
Happy birthday… Feliz cumpleaños
Turn it up… Súbele el volumen
Click, click, flash… Flash, flash, clic
Capture the moment… Captura el momento
Let's celebrate tonight.

[Verse]
The phone… El teléfono
Rings and we sing along.
The computer… La computadora
Shows us the best songs.
The internet… El internet
Keeps us all connected.
The screen… La pantalla
Lights up with every color.
The email… El correo
Brings wishes from afar.
We're dancing, we're laughing.

[Hook]
Happy birthday… Feliz cumpleaños
Turn it up… Súbele el volumen
Click, click, flash… Flash, flash, clic
Capture the moment… Captura el momento
Let's celebrate tonight.

[Verse]
The music's loud… La música está fuerte
We feel the beat.
Las luces… The lights
Make everything complete.
Un brindis… A toast
To memories we make.
With friends around… Con amigos aquí
Every second's a break.
Technology's our guide.

[Bridge]
Las velas… The candles
Glow as we make a wish.
